propositions: CLI `rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD` with out-of-worktree `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` falsely reports no commit references the ticket because `close_precheck` derives code_root from tracker parent instead of current code worktree

With a custom tracker directory outside the code repository, `close_precheck._completion_precheck` correctly reads ticket state from the relocated tracker but runs git commit scans against the tracker parent directory, missing valid referencing commits in the code worktree

The defect affects completion-gate configuration and referencing commit detection; depending on gate setup at the tracker parent, it either falsely rejects valid closes or silently ignores enabled gates and closes unsigned

Code root must be resolved through `config.repo_root(repo_root)` (explicit → REBAR_ROOT → cwd Git toplevel) while tracker reads remain independent via `config.tracker_dir(repo_root)` to handle documented and supported out-of-worktree tracker scenarios
